title: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker from Kamigawa and part of the strike team, who wakes on the sands of New Phyrexia stripped of his sword and his tanuki drone.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A white-haired planeswalker and Kaito's childhood friend, who can barely hold herself on New Phyrexia and keeps flickering back into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker and lithomancer who fights with shaped metal and stone blades; she is quietly infected by Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker and Prince of Kaldheim, found as a living statue held by cables and freed by the others.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A red-haired Mirran healer who is immune to compleation and guides the planeswalkers down through Mirrodin.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A Mirran Resistance leader who told the Mirrans the planeswalkers were coming.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A member of the Gatewatch whose call brought the strike team to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who is rumored to have set up the defensive barrier that scattered the team.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: Kaito's small, friendly spirit that takes the form of a tanuki drone; it is lost along with his sword.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The fully compleated plane that was once Mirrodin, which the strike team has invaded.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The original metal plane, whose real surface lies beneath the Monumental Facade; Phyrexians call the layer beneath Mirrex.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Kaito's home plane, which is under threat from Phyrexia.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose hedrons Nahiri recognizes in the statue's stone.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Tyvar's home plane, of which he is a prince.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, to which the Wanderer is pulled back when she cannot hold her anchor.

entities.name: Monumental Facade
entities.description: A shell the Phyrexians built around Mirrodin, covered in metal sand and monuments, where Phyrexia sends its creations to fight each other.

entities.name: Lowlight
entities.description: A Mirran camp beneath the Facade where the Resistance's assault teams gather.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: A deeper layer of New Phyrexia where the rest of the strike team is to gather.

entities.name: Lacuna
entities.description: A gravity-warping tunnel the Mirrans captured that carries travelers down to the Furnace Layer.

entities.name: Zendikari hedron
entities.description: Stone from Zendikar that Nahiri recognizes in the statue of Tyvar.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde that rules New Phyrexia and sets traps and barriers for intruders.

entities.name: The Resistance
entities.description: The surviving Mirrans fighting Phyrexia from beneath the Monumental Facade.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker alliance whose call summoned the strike team.

events.summary: Kaito, hit by a wall of electrostatic wind on entering New Phyrexia, lies hypnotized on the metal beach, sure it is paradise.
events.quote: New Phyrexia wasn't a peril, it was a paradise, and he should just relax and let it wash over him

events.summary: The Wanderer shakes Kaito and strikes him in the face, breaking the hypnotic spell so that he hears the battle around him.
events.quote: he realized that what he'd taken for the sound of waves was actually the sound of metal clashing on metal

events.summary: Kaito finds his sword and tanuki drone gone, and the Wanderer begins flickering out of the plane.
events.quote: He grabbed instinctively for his sword

events.summary: Nahiri kills a Phyrexian construct by summoning the metal sand against it and driving her blade through it.
events.quote: She twisted once, and the shape beneath the mounded sand was still.

events.summary: Nahiri explains that a planar shield scattered the team on arrival, and that she shook off the sand's hypnosis because it is made of metal.
events.quote: we slammed into some sort of planar shield when we breached New Phyrexia

events.summary: Nahiri reveals a scratch on her neck and shows her blood still runs red, assuring Kaito she is fine.
events.quote: My blood's still red. No oil. I'll be fine.

events.summary: The group sets off across the metal desert toward the next landing zone, Nahiri warning that nothing Phyrexian can be trusted.
events.quote: You can't trust anything Phyrexian.

events.summary: The group finds a statue of an elf containing Zendikari hedron stone, suspended in cables, and Nahiri declares him one of their own.
events.quote: That's a Zendikari hedron.

events.summary: Kaito and Nahiri attack the living cables and cut the statue free, and the Wanderer kneels beside him.
events.quote: until, with a loud snapping sound, the last one broke and dumped him to the ground

events.summary: The freed statue reverts to flesh and introduces himself as Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.
events.quote: I am Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.

events.summary: The Wanderer finally flickers away, unable to stay on the plane, having seen Kaito out of the first danger.
events.quote: He turned to the Wanderer, intending to say something to boost her spirits and bolster her strength.

events.summary: The group reaches a Mirran camp where the healer Melira greets them, explaining that Koth told them the planeswalkers were coming.
events.quote: You're the ones Koth told us were coming. I'm Melira.

events.summary: Melira explains the Monumental Facade, the shell Phyrexia built around Mirrodin, and that the rest of the team should gather in the Furnace Layer.
events.quote: This is the Monumental Facade,

events.summary: Melira collapses a section of the Facade with explosive charges, dropping the group down to Mirrodin.
events.quote: the ground dropped out from under their feet

events.summary: Nahiri catches the falling earth with her magic and slows their descent to the ground.
events.quote: the lithomancer caught hold of them and slowed their descent

events.summary: Melira tells them she is immune to compleation and that is why the Resistance lets her roam unguarded.
events.quote: I'm immune. It's why the Resistance lets me move around without a guard

events.summary: The group leaps into the lacuna to descend toward the Furnace Layer.
events.quote: Nahiri leapt without hesitation, and Kaito jumped after her.

events.summary: Nahiri discovers the wound on her neck has become a slick Phyrexian protrusion and realizes she is infected, but decides to conceal it.
events.quote: She pulled her hand away with a hiss of dismay

events.summary: Nahiri resolves to hide the infection and get her companions as far as she can before she succumbs.
events.quote: it was best to get them as far as she possibly could before she succumbed

events.summary: The Wanderer returns to the razed camp too late and finds her companions gone.
events.quote: She had returned from the Blind Eternities too late, and they were lost.

relations.note: childhood friend who fights beside him
relations.quote: She had been able to hold on long enough to see her childhood friend out of the initial danger

relations.note: fight together on the strike team
relations.quote: If it is, we take the bait,

relations.note: answered the call of Karn and the Gatewatch
relations.quote: We came following Karn and the Gatewatch's call

relations.note: healer and immune scout of the Resistance
relations.quote: It's why the Resistance lets me move around without a guard

relations.note: Koth had her watch for the planeswalkers
relations.quote: why Koth had me watching for you
They built a shell around our plane

relations.note: Phyrexians trapped the surviving Mirrans beneath the shell
relations.quote: trapping those of us who'd survived to keep fighting underneath
